name: Alert category
description: Subject categories for public warnings, taken unchanged from OASIS CAP 1.2. Adopted rather than invented because alerting systems worldwide already route and filter on these codes, and a warning that does not route is a warning nobody receives.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Meteorological
hasDefinedTerm.description: Storm, flood, extreme heat or cold, wildfire weather.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Law enforcement, military, homeland and local security
Medical and public health
hasDefinedTerm.description: Where SpecialAnnouncement's pandemic properties would apply.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Pollution and environmental
hasDefinedTerm.description: Includes boil-water notices and air quality warnings.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Utility, telecommunication and other non-transport infrastructure
Chemical, biological, radiological, nuclear or high-yield explosive threat
